shape.condition: Output tensor shape is smaller than required operation result

memory.condition: Output tensor is a view sharing storage with insufficient capacity

root_cause.description: PyTorch allows implicit resizing of an undersized output view. The tensor metadata may be updated without reallocating the underlying storage, causing unsafe writes beyond the original view boundary.

bug_oracle.description: Memory outside the valid output view region is modified after executing torch.matmul.

tensor_construction: Create a smaller sliced view as output tensor
Use the view as torch.matmul out argument
constraints: out tensor must be a view
oracle_construction: Place sentinel values after output storage
Check whether sentinel values are modified
